Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.documents

Class StepUpProblemMapper

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.documents.StepUpProblemMapper
@Component public class StepUpProblemMapper extends Object
Maps a step-up request of the resource server onto the extra members of the step-up-required problem, the values the SPA passes back to GET /bff/login. They are values the resource server chose, so they are kept within what that endpoint accepts, otherwise the login would answer 400 and the user could never step up:
  • acrValues: only the references of the accepted format are kept, and none at all when the result would be empty or longer than the login allows;
  • maxAge: capped at the login's maximum, which is stricter than what the resource server asked for, so the new sign-in still satisfies it.
